name: Battery storage cabinet
summary: A generic storage-equipment envelope linked to the selected battery system.
description: A battery cabinet contains the storage equipment defined by its product system. A BESS arrangement can also include power conversion, control and auxiliary equipment. The GA should identify those equipment boundaries rather than treat every cabinet as an identical storage block.

The original envelope illustration is unscaled and has no manufacturer dimensions. Follow the cited public resources to the exact product, then use its current drawing and installation information for engineering work.
readingNotes: Match the cabinet identifier to the selected system configuration.
Keep storage, conversion and control equipment distinct.
drawingChecklist: Reference the product and installation documentation.
Identify interfaces and specified access requirements.
Link the cabinet to system and equipment schedules.
distinction: A BESS cabinet is not necessarily a complete BESS. Equipment scope and installation requirements are product-specific.
